nodes.label: The Gauntlet
nodes.rationale: Pipeline that punishes every strategy with costs, validation, and operational criteria before live deployment. Most strategies die — that is the point.

nodes.label: Strategy Sourcing Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Strategies are hypotheses from public testable sources (papers, factor libraries, quant platforms), rebuilt cleanly, not proprietary assets. The edge comes from honest validation and execution discipline, not clever math.

nodes.label: Strategy Retirement Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Retire on: Sharpe < 0.5 over 3 months, max DD exceeding MC 95th percentile, 20 consecutive losing trades, slippage > 2x model for 30 trades, reconciliation failure > 5% over 7 days, or cointegration p > 0.05 for 2 consecutive retests.

nodes.label: Live Deployment Gate
nodes.rationale: Progressive deployment: gauntlet to paper ops (30d + 100-200 trades) to live dry-run to manual approval to 10-25% capital to scale on conditions to retire on underperformance. Single-strategy first-live until 3+ months clean operation.
